Both `root>ghost` and `root>visible` are positioned at the same coordinates (x=0, y=0). Although `root>ghost` has a width and height of 0, its `overflow` property is `visible`, meaning the text "Important warning" will still be rendered starting from its origin. Since `root>visible` also starts at (0,0) and contains the text "Everything is fine", the glyphs from both nodes are drawn starting at the same pixel location and will overlap.
